text:
Claire (partnerships): Hey team — RetailX co-sell launch is T+7. Dropping the creative bundle here for a quick ops check. Main asks: 1) logo lockup on dark/white, 2) marketplace tile crop + CTA copy, 3) alt text and accessibility check, 4) legal ok on the one-line quote. Links: https://s3.redwood/retailx/creative/v1.zip :package:
Jamal (design): Downloading now. quick glance: retailx_logo_horizontal.svg looks fine on white but the white-outline version is fuzzy at 2x. Can we get a vectored mask for the drop shadow? :eyes:
Owen (marketing): For the marketplace tile we should use 1200x628 for marketplace preview and 600x600 for listing thumbnail. Proposed CTA: "Run RetailOps with Redwood — Book a demo". Thoughts?
Priya (legal): Quote copy? please paste the exact line you plan to use. Need to check partner attribution and trademark usage per co-marketing MOU.
Claire (partnerships): Quote draft: "RetailX reduced inference cost by 42% using Redwood Dedicated." Also attaching RetailX brand guidelines `RetailX_BrandGuidelines_2025.pdf`
Eli (product): Is that 42% a measured number from the pilot or projected? Legal will likely ask for backing. If measured, include timeframe and workload (e.g., Q4 2025, inference for search ranking).
Claire (partnerships): Good catch — it's measured across their search-ranking workload, pilot Jan–Mar 2025. I'll add that context to the one-liner.
Jamal (design): On the dark lockup: attached `retailx_lockup_dark_v2.svg` (no outer glow). I can produce a 2x PNG export once we confirm spacing. Also recommend increasing clearspace to 12px at 72dpi for small thumbnails.
Owen (marketing): Alt text suggestions for the tile: "Redwood + RetailX co-sell: faster product search powered by efficient LLM inference". Shorter variant for thumbnails: "Redwood with RetailX — faster search". Both approved from my side. :thumbsup:
Priya (legal): With the updated quote context (pilot + timeframe) I'm ok, but we need partner sign-off on the numeric claim. Requesting RetailX legal to countersign the quote PDF. Also: confirm RetailX trademark usage matches section 3 of MOU.
asset-bot: Asset check complete — missing file: `retailx_logo_white_outline.ai`. Also flagged non-compliant color: `#f3f2f5` used on hero gradient (RetailX palette requires minimum contrast ratio 4.5:1).
Jamal (design): I'll rebuild the white-outline ai and fix gradient to `#e8e6ea` to meet contrast. Uploading updated zip in 10m.
Owen (marketing): Can we also get a version of the hero with the quote typeset (desktop + mobile crops)? I can run A/B for CTA text.
Claire (partnerships): Schedule: bundle final by EOD tomorrow, partner sign-off by Thu, marketplace listing goes live Mon. Thanks all — tagging RetailX PM for final sign: @retailx-pm.
Priya (legal): I'll prepare a one-page approval stamp PDF for RetailX to sign.
Eli (product): FYI let's add a short tech note to the solution brief: model family, quantization profile, and sample latency numbers. Partners ask for that in the marketplace listing.
Jamal (design): uploaded `retailx_creative_v2.zip` to the same S3 path — includes 1200x628, 600x600, icon set, and the fixed AI logo.
Owen (marketing): Reviewed the upload. CTA options in `cta_variants.txt`. My pick: "See a demo" for the tile, "Book a demo" for the landing hero.
Claire (partnerships): Perfect. Closing loop once partner signs. If anyone sees any final blocker ping me here. :rocket:
